purpose: Authoritative status record for the unified property evidence fixture governance layer.
registry_rules: Governance status is derived from the manifest and recorded validation.
A PASSED governance status does not mean legal-source verification is complete.
A PASSED governance status does not mean live official-record retrieval occurred.
blocking_conditions: Active fixture impact event has not completed dependent revalidation.
Substantive legal-source verification remains separate and incomplete for the property-title-live pathway.
No live official property record has been retrieved and verified through the production evidence path.
warnings: Technical governance passing is not legal verification.
Synthetic fixture validation does not establish real property facts.
No publication-ready status may be inferred from this registry.
next_state_rule: Governance may remain PASSED while active revalidation is open; closure and pathway publication require their own explicit gates.
